body:
When installing a local VSIX using the VS Code CLI, the extension installs successfully, but the CLI emits Node.js deprecation warning `DEP0169`.

### Steps to reproduce

1. Open PowerShell.
2. Enable deprecation tracing:

```powershell
$env:NODE_OPTIONS="--trace-deprecation"
```
3. Install any local VSIX:
```powershell
code --install-extension .\restage-studio-0.0.8.vsix --force
```

**The extension installs successfully, but the following warning is printed:**
**(node:35280) [DEP0169] DeprecationWarning: `url.parse()` behavior is not standardized and prone to errors that have security implications. Use the WHATWG URL API instead. CVEs are not issued for `url.parse()` vulnerabilities.**
    at urlParse (node:url:136:13)
    at ey (/AppData/Local/Programs/Microsoft%20VS%20Code/8a7abeba6e/resources/app/out/vs/code/node/cliProcessMain.js:475:22219)
    at po.request (/AppData/Local/Programs/Microsoft%20VS%20Code/8a7abeba6e/resources/app/out/vs/code/node/cliProcessMain.js:475:23676)
    at async $i.queryRawGalleryExtensions (/AppData/Local/Programs/Microsoft%20VS%20Code/8a7abeba6e/resources/app/out/vs/code/node/cliProcessMain.js:453:51717)
    at async $i.queryGalleryExtensions (/AppData/Local/Programs/Microsoft%20VS%20Code/8a7abeba6e/resources/app/out/vs/code/node/cliProcessMain.js:453:47890)
    at async $i.getExtensionsUsingQueryApi (/AppData/Local/Programs/Microsoft%20VS%20Code/8a7abeba6e/resources/app/out/vs/code/node/cliProcessMain.js:453:40341)
    at async $i.getExtensionsUsingResourceApi (/AppData/Local/Programs/Microsoft%20VS%20Code/8a7abeba6e/resources/app/out/vs/code/node/cliProcessMain.js:453:41650)
    at async $i.getExtensions (/AppData/Local/Programs/Microsoft%20VS%20Code/8a7abeba6e/resources/app/out/vs/code/node/cliProcessMain.js:453:39276)
    at async Ps.updateMetadata (/AppData/Local/Programs/Microsoft%20VS%20Code/8a7abeba6e/resources/app/out/vs/code/node/cliProcessMain.js:464:64646)


**Expected behavior**

The VS Code CLI should not call Node's deprecated url.parse() API and should not emit DEP0169.

comments.body:
﻿Same family of Node deprecation noise also shows up when F5-debugging an extension: the **parent** window Debug Console prints `DEP0040` (`punycode`) and `DEP0169` (`url.parse()`), attributed to `extensionHostProcess.js` (not the extension under test). Reproduced on VS Code 1.131.0 / Windows with `--disable-extensions`.

Dedicated report: https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/issues/328548

title: VS Code CLI emits DEP0169 url.parse() deprecation warning when installing a VSIX
